newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 5.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - August 5.

text.p: -- Lone Star Steakhouse & Saloon Inc said it expects third quarter earnings per share to be $0.10-$0.13 below analysts' estimates. First Call earnings estimates range from $0.45 to $0.50 per share. Continuing declines in average unit volumes reduced margins in the first part of the current quarter, and spending on advertising and marketing in the second half will further reduce margins from expected levels, the company said. The stock closed at 22 Monday.

-- Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp said it named Jack Bovender Jr as president and chief operating officer, succeeding David Vandewater, who resigned last week. Bovender is a former chief operating officer of Hospital Corp of America. Columbia/HCA closed at 33-1/4.
-- Sun International Hotels Ltd reported second quarter earnings of $0.92 per share, up from $0.35 a year ago. The stock last traded at 35.

-- Time Warner Inc filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a shelf offering of up to $449.4 million in guaranteed debt securities to be issued by Time Warner Cos Inc. Time Warner closed at 54-9/16.
